Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and
reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the knee findings observed on
examination. Imaging and physical examination clearly confirm the injury, and the findings are consistent with the
reported mechanism. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain involving the same region, which resolved
completely without residual limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Over a course of 23 visits, care
progressed through a conventional sequence of therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and activity modification.
Symptoms, strength, and mobility improved steadily, and the frequency of visits tapered as the patient recovered.
Billing recodrs reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service rendered, with no repeated billing. The
patient is currently near maximum medical improvement, with residual stiffness expected to continue to resolve with a
home exercise program.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
